script: When she asks how old you are, never just say the number. Here's what to say instead: Old enough to know what I want. If you're close, dinner's on me. A man who apologizes for his age looks old. A man who owns it looks wise. She isn't checking your age. She's checking if you're comfortable in your own skin.
